en: The Dhāraṇī Sūtra of the Heart-Seal of All Buddhas,
translated by the Tripiṭaka Master of the Western Heaven, the Imperially Appointed Grand Officer of Dispersed Rank,
Acting Assistant Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, and Great Master of the Transmission of the Teaching.
Translated by the Subject Fātian, by Imperial Decree: Thus have I heard:

At one time, the Buddha was dwelling within the maṇḍala of the Bodhisattva Palace Adorned with Myriad Jewels in the Tuṣita Heaven. There were countless bodhisattvas, adorned with the primary and secondary marks, sons of the Tathāgatas who knew the true limit of phenomena (dharmatā), all of whom had come from various buddha-fields; each prostrated at the Buddha’s feet and withdrew to sit to one side.
At that time, the World-Honored One addressed the great assembly, saying:
"O sons of good family!
There is a dhāraṇī called the 'Seal of the Buddha-Mind,' which has been taught by Tathāgatas as numerous as the sands of the Ganges."
I now benefit the devas and humans of Tuṣita, so that they may attain corresponding happiness.

If a son of good family upholds, recites, explains, or hears this dhāraṇī, you should know that such a person will obtain the knowledge of past lives, have heavy karma eliminated, and constantly experience happiness without falling into the evil realms;

they will be loved by all people, protected by all people, and possess abundant and fulfilling worldly and supramundane wealth; neither humans nor non-humans shall invade or harm them; throughout a cycle of a thousand kalpas, they shall not be born in the realm of Māra, and they will swiftly realize unsurpassed bodhi.
At that time, the World-Honored One spoke this mantra:
*Tadyathā | mṛte mṛte | mṛtimṛte | samantabuddhānugate | buddha buddha | buddha buddha | buddha | ānanda | buddhavaiśaye | ānanda | dharmadeśanā | svāhā.* The Buddha said:
"This Great Dharani of the Buddha’s Heart-Seal possesses great majestic power and brings benefit to sentient beings."
"I shall now further proclaim the *dhāraṇī* of the heart-seal (*hṛdaya-mudrā*) of all Buddhas, which says:
*Tadyathā | hara hara*."

"Vāgati svāhā. At that time, when the World-Honored One spoke this mantra, all the celestial palaces, the entire great earth, the mountains, rivers, forests, wilds, Mount Sumeru, and so forth, shook in six ways, and the great ocean surged and boiled.
The Māra King, filled with grief and fear, joined his palms in refuge and said:
"May all Buddhas of the three periods of time and all Bodhisattvas grant me fearlessness; I and my retinue vow to protect the Buddha-dharma."

At that time, when the World-Honored One had finished preaching this Dharma, all the bodhisattvas, as well as the devas and humans, having heard what the Buddha taught, believed, accepted, and practiced it accordingly.
